definitions.gloss: full repayment; paying off a debt completely
definitions.explanation: The act of finishing payment on a loan, debt, or other financial obligation. Means paying the entire amount owed, with nothing remaining.

examples.japanese: ローンを{完済|かんさい}した。
{住宅|じゅうたく}ローンの{完済|かんさい}まであと{五年|ごねん}かかる。
examples.english: It will take five more years to pay off the mortgage.

examples.japanese: {借金|しゃっきん}を{完済|かんさい}して、やっと{肩|かた}の{荷|に}が{下|お}りた。
examples.english: After paying off all my debts, I finally felt a weight lifted from my shoulders.

notes: Composed of {完|かん} (complete) + {済|さい} (settle, finish). A financial term commonly used with loans and debts. Common collocations: ローンを{完済|かんさい}する (pay off a loan), {借金|しゃっきん}を{完済|かんさい}する (pay off a debt), {完済|かんさい}{証明書|しょうめいしょ} (certificate of full repayment). Homophone: {関西|かんさい} (Kansai region) — different kanji and meaning.
